title: 仰卧换一只脚
description: 成人仰卧屈膝，交替轻抬一脚，骨盆保持水平。

art_direction.medium: crisp digital comic ink and quiet halftone shadows
art_direction.scene: A fictional adult lies supine on a mat with one knee bent and foot planted while the other foot lifts just a short distance from the floor. Arms rest comfortably at the sides, pelvis level, and shoulders supported. Capture the quiet midpoint of this alternating march without any fast movement. The horizontal frame includes an open window, a plain water bottle, and an uncluttered mat so the simple control exercise feels approachable. Use a soft graphite-and-watercolor illustration with precise posture contours, luminous color washes, and cool blue balanced by warm ochre. Create one original 1536x1024 wordless scene, fictional fully clothed adults, natural anatomy; no brands, arrows or panels.
